_cms: CMS module: Branding → Official associations. Each association is independently manageable: add, edit, reorder (order), hide (placements), activate/deactivate (enabled), delete. RULES: enable an association ONLY after formal written approval; enter the EXACT approved wording; upload ONLY official logo assets supplied by the organization (logo: path under /public). Never use unofficial or recreated logos or seals.

associations.note: PENDING — do not enable until the association is formally approved. Set `wording` to the exact approved phrase (e.g. as approved: 'Backed by Startup India' or 'In Association with Startup India') and upload the official logo asset.
